name: Midjourney
description: The industry's leading AI image generator, creating stunning artistic visuals from text prompts. Trusted by 15M+ users including professional artists, game designers, and creative agencies for unparalleled style consistency and photorealistic output. Generates high-resolution images in seconds with intuitive Discord-based interface.

examples.prompt: A majestic dragon flying over a misty mountain at sunset, fantasy art style, highly detailed
Cyberpunk cityscape with neon lights, rainy streets, cinematic lighting

description_en: The industry's leading AI image generator, creating stunning artistic visuals from text prompts.
description_zh: 行业领先的 AI 图像生成器，可根据文字提示词创作出极具艺术感的视觉作品。深受 1500 万以上用户信赖，包括专业艺术家、游戏设计师和创意机构，以无与伦比的风格一致性与照片级真实输出著称。几秒内即可生成高分辨率图像，并配备直观的 Discord 交互界面。

name: DALL-E 3
description: OpenAI's text-to-image model, available inside ChatGPT, the OpenAI API and Bing Image Creator. It follows long, detailed prompts closely and renders legible text inside images.

examples.prompt: A cozy cabin in the woods during a snowstorm, warm lights glowing through windows
An astronaut riding a horse on Mars, wearing a space suit, realistic photography

description_en: OpenAI's text-to-image model, available inside ChatGPT, the OpenAI API and Bing Image Creator.
description_zh: OpenAI 的文本生成图像模型，可在 ChatGPT、OpenAI API 和 Bing Image Creator 中使用。它能紧密遵循长而详细的提示词，并在图像中渲染出清晰可读的文字。

name: Stable Diffusion
description: The open-weights image model behind much of the generative art ecosystem. Runs on your own GPU or through hosted services, with fine-tunes, LoRAs and full control over sampling.

examples.prompt: Japanese garden in spring, cherry blossoms, traditional architecture, peaceful atmosphere
Steampunk mechanical owl with intricate gears, Victorian style, studio photography

description_en: The open-weights image model behind much of the generative art ecosystem.
description_zh: 支撑起整个生成式艺术生态的开源权重图像模型。可在自有 GPU 上运行，也可通过托管服务使用，支持微调模型、LoRA 以及对采样过程的完全控制。

name: Notion AI
description: AI built directly into Notion workspaces: drafts and summarizes docs, answers questions across your wiki and databases, and fills database properties with AI autofill.

examples.prompt: Summarize this 30-minute team meeting transcript into key action items and decisions
Organize and structure these scattered project notes into a clear, actionable plan

description_en: AI built directly into Notion workspaces: drafts and summarizes docs, answers questions across your wiki and databases, and fills database properties with AI
description_zh: 直接内置于 Notion 工作区的 AI：可起草和总结文档、跨 wiki 与数据库回答问题，并通过 AI 自动填充数据库属性。

name: ChatGPT
description: OpenAI's conversational assistant for writing, analysis, coding, data and image work, with voice mode, file and document upload, and web search on paid plans.

examples.prompt: Write a professional email to request a meeting with a potential client for a product demo
Draft a comprehensive blog post about the benefits of remote work for modern companies

description_en: OpenAI's conversational assistant for writing, analysis, coding, data and image work, with voice mode, file and document upload, and web search on paid plans.
description_zh: OpenAI 的对话式助手，适用于写作、分析、编程、数据处理和图像任务，付费方案支持语音模式、文件与文档上传以及联网搜索。

name: GitHub Copilot
description: The world's most widely-used AI coding assistant, helping 1M+ developers write code 55% faster. Integrates directly into VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Neovim. Supports 100+ programming languages with context-aware code suggestions, function generation, and intelligent debugging assistance.

examples.prompt: Write a function to validate email addresses with regex in TypeScript
Refactor this messy Python script for better readability and performance

description_en: The world's most widely-used AI coding assistant, helping developers write code 55% faster.
description_zh: 全球使用最广泛的 AI 编程助手，帮助 100 万以上开发者将编码速度提升 55%。可直接集成到 VS Code、JetBrains 系列 IDE 和 Neovim 中。支持 100 多种编程语言，提供上下文感知的代码建议、函数生成和智能调试辅助。

name: ElevenLabs
description: Industry-leading AI voice synthesis platform trusted by 1M+ creators for generating lifelike speech in 128 languages. Features industry-leading voice cloning, emotional range control, and instant voice mirroring. Used by publishers, game developers, and content creators for professional-grade voiceovers.

examples.prompt: Create a deep, authoritative voiceover for a nature documentary about African wildlife
Generate a warm, friendly podcast intro with subtle background music

description_en: Industry-leading AI voice synthesis for lifelike speech in 128 languages.
description_zh: 行业领先的 AI 语音合成平台，获得 100 万以上创作者信赖，可生成 128 种语言的逼真语音。具备业界领先的语音克隆、情绪范围控制和即时声音复刻功能。出版商、游戏开发者和内容创作者用它制作专业级配音。

name: Runway ML
description: A browser suite for AI video generation and editing: text-to-video, image-to-video, motion brush, inpainting and rotoscoping on a single timeline.

examples.prompt: Remove the background from this video clip and replace with a futuristic cityscape
Transform this footage into a cinematic slow-motion sequence with color grading

description_en: A browser suite for AI video generation and editing: text-to-video, image-to-video, motion brush, inpainting and rotoscoping on a single timeline.
description_zh: 浏览器端的 AI 视频生成与剪辑套件：支持文生视频、图生视频、运动笔刷、局部重绘和抠像，全部集中在同一条时间线上完成。

name: Perplexity AI
description: AI-powered search engine providing cited, real-time answers to complex questions. Used by 10M+ researchers, professionals, and students for instant research synthesis. Features thread-based conversations, source citations, and Pro mode with GPT-4 and Claude 3 Sonnet for advanced reasoning.

examples.prompt: Research and summarize the latest trends in AI-powered productivity tools for 2026
Compare the features and pricing of top project management software with citations

description_en: AI-powered search engine providing cited, real-time answers to complex questions.
description_zh: AI 驱动的搜索引擎，为复杂问题提供带引用来源的实时答案。已有 1000 万以上研究人员、职场人士和学生使用它即时整合研究资料。支持话题串式对话、来源引用，以及使用 GPT-4 和 Claude 3 Sonnet 进行高级推理的 Pro 模式。

name: Whisper
description: OpenAI's open-source speech-to-text model. Runs locally or through an API, transcribes 90+ languages, and produces punctuation and timestamps for captions.

examples.prompt: Transcribe this 2-hour podcast episode into text with timestamps and speaker identification
Convert this Japanese audio file to English text with high accuracy

description_en: OpenAI's open-source speech-to-text model. Runs locally or through an API, transcribes 90+ languages, and produces punctuation and timestamps for captions.
description_zh: OpenAI 的开源语音转文字模型。可本地运行或通过 API 调用，支持 90 多种语言的转写，并能输出标点和时间戳以生成字幕。

name: Cursor
description: The AI-first code editor built for pair programming. Combines the power of GPT-4 and Claude with a purpose-built IDE featuring predictive code, intelligent autocomplete, and conversational debugging. Loved by indie developers and startups for its blazing-fast performance and collaborative features.

examples.prompt: Debug this React component that's throwing a useState hook error
Explain this complex algorithm and suggest optimizations

description_en: The AI-first code editor built for pair programming with developers.
description_zh: 专为结对编程打造的 AI 优先代码编辑器。将 GPT-4 与 Claude 的能力融入定制化 IDE，具备预测式代码、智能补全和对话式调试。以极快的速度和协作功能深受独立开发者与初创团队喜爱。

name: Obsidian Copilot
description: An Obsidian community plugin that brings chat, embeddings and command-based AI actions into your vault, so answers come from your own notes.

examples.prompt: Connect and summarize related notes about machine learning from my vault
Extract key insights and create a mind map outline from this research paper

description_en: An Obsidian community plugin that brings chat, embeddings and command-based AI actions into your vault, so answers come from your own notes.
description_zh: Obsidian 社区插件，将聊天、向量嵌入和基于命令的 AI 操作引入你的笔记库，让答案来自你自己的笔记。

name: Sora
description: OpenAI's video generation model. Creates short clips from text with scene continuity and camera movement, and is available inside the Sora app and ChatGPT.

examples.prompt: Generate a video of a majestic whale swimming through bioluminescent deep ocean
Create a cinematic scene of a futuristic Tokyo street with flying cars and neon lights

description_en: OpenAI's video generation model. Creates short clips from text with scene continuity and camera movement, and is available inside the Sora app and ChatGPT.
description_zh: OpenAI 的视频生成模型。可根据文字生成带有场景连贯性和镜头运动的短片，可在 Sora 应用和 ChatGPT 中使用。

name: Tabnine
description: An AI coding assistant with autocomplete and chat that can run fully local or self-hosted, with team-level policy controls over what code the model sees.

examples.prompt: Complete this C# async method for reading data from a database
Suggest test cases for this user authentication function

description_en: An AI coding assistant with autocomplete and chat that can run fully local or self-hosted, with team-level policy controls over what code the model sees.
description_zh: 具备代码补全与聊天功能的 AI 编程助手，可完全本地运行或自行部署，并提供团队级别的策略控制，决定模型可以查看哪些代码。

name: Jasper
description: Enterprise-grade AI writing platform trusted by 100,000+ marketing teams at companies like Google, Anthropic, and DoorDash. Features 60+ copywriting templates, Brand Voice customization, and Campaign generation for full content workflows. Creates SEO-optimized blog posts, ad copy, and social content at scale.

examples.prompt: Generate a compelling product description for a new smartwatch with health monitoring features
Create engaging social media posts for a coffee brand launch campaign

description_en: Enterprise-grade AI writing platform for marketing teams and content creators.
description_zh: 企业级 AI 写作平台，深受 Google、Anthropic、DoorDash 等公司 10 万以上营销团队信赖。提供 60 多种文案模板、品牌语调定制，以及面向完整内容工作流的 Campaign 生成功能。可规模化产出 SEO 优化的博客文章、广告文案和社媒内容。

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe's generative image and video models, wired into Photoshop, Illustrator and Express. Generative fill, text-to-image and commercially safe training data.

examples.prompt: Watercolor painting of a sunset over the ocean, soft brush strokes, warm colors
3D text effect "DREAM" floating in clouds, golden hour lighting, magical atmosphere

description_en: Adobe's generative image and video models, wired into Photoshop, Illustrator and Express. Generative fill, text-to-image and commercially safe training data.
description_zh: Adobe 的生成式图像与视频模型，深度接入 Photoshop、Illustrator 和 Express。支持生成式填充、文生图像，并使用可商用的安全训练数据。

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's assistant for long documents, writing and analysis, with a large context window, Projects for grouped work, and Artifacts for live code and documents.

examples.prompt: Write a thoughtful analysis of the ethical implications of artificial intelligence in healthcare
Draft a creative short story about a time traveler who accidentally changes history

description_en: Anthropic's assistant for long documents, writing and analysis, with a large context window, Projects for grouped work, and Artifacts for live code
description_zh: Anthropic 推出的助手，擅长长文档处理、写作与分析，具备超大上下文窗口、用于归类工作的 Projects，以及可实时呈现代码与文档的 Artifacts。

name: Gemini
description: Google's multimodal assistant, connected to Search, Workspace and Android. Reads images, files and video, and works across Gmail, Docs and Sheets.

examples.prompt: Write a research summary comparing renewable energy sources for a sustainability report
Create a detailed travel itinerary for a 7-day trip to Japan with cultural recommendations

description_en: Google's multimodal assistant, connected to Search, Workspace and Android. Reads images, files and video, and works across Gmail, Docs and Sheets.
description_zh: Google 的多模态助手，打通搜索、Workspace 与 Android。可读取图片、文件和视频，并跨 Gmail、Docs 和 Sheets 工作。

name: Writesonic
description: A content marketing platform for AI article drafting, SEO-optimized copy and brand-voice chat, with integrations for publishing workflows.

examples.prompt: Generate an SEO-optimized blog post about digital marketing strategies for small businesses
Write compelling meta descriptions and headlines for an e-commerce website selling organic skincare products

description_en: A content marketing platform for AI article drafting, SEO-optimized copy and brand-voice chat, with integrations for publishing workflows.
description_zh: 内容营销平台，提供 AI 文章起草、SEO 优化文案和品牌语调聊天，并支持与发布工作流集成。

name: Rytr
description: The most affordable AI writing tool trusted by 10M+ creators worldwide. Write blog posts, emails, social media, and marketing copy in 30+ languages — all starting at just $9/month. 3x faster than Jasper at half the price, with built-in plagiarism checker and SEO optimizer. Perfect for solopreneurs, bloggers, and small businesses who want premium quality without the enterprise budget.

examples.prompt: Write a persuasive landing page copy for a SaaS project management tool
Create engaging video script ideas for a YouTube channel about personal finance

description_en: The most affordable AI writing tool trusted by 10M+ creators worldwide.

use_cases.title: SEO Blog Posts
use_cases.detail: Generate 2,000-word optimized articles with keyword targeting in under 2 minutes

use_cases.title: Email Campaigns
use_cases.detail: Write high-converting cold emails and newsletters with proven AIDA and PAS frameworks

use_cases.title: Social Media Content
use_cases.detail: Create 30 days of social posts in one sitting — captions, hooks, and hashtags included

pros: Unbeatable value — $9/month with 40+ templates and unlimited words on premium plan
30+ language support makes it ideal for global content teams
Built-in plagiarism checker and SEO optimizer included at no extra cost
cons: Long-form editor lacks the advanced customization of enterprise tools like Jasper
Template variety is good but not as extensive as Copy.ai's 90+ options

description_zh: 最实惠的 AI 写作工具，全球 1000 万以上创作者信赖。支持 30 多种语言撰写博客、邮件、社媒和营销文案，每月仅需 9 美元起。比 Jasper 快 3 倍而价格仅为其一半，内置查重与 SEO 优化工具。非常适合想以非企业预算获得优质内容的个体创业者、博主和小型企业。

name: QuillBot
description: Paraphrasing, grammar checking, summarization and citation tools aimed at students and editors, with a browser extension and Word add-in.

examples.prompt: Paraphrase this academic paragraph about climate change into a more casual and engaging tone
Expand and elaborate this brief bullet point summary into a comprehensive paragraph

description_en: Paraphrasing, grammar checking, summarization and citation tools aimed at students and editors, with a browser extension and Word add-in.
description_zh: 面向学生和编辑的改写、语法检查、摘要与引用工具，提供浏览器扩展和 Word 插件。

name: VEED.io
description: Browser-based AI video editor used by 50M+ creators, with 100,000+ 5-star reviews. Auto-generate subtitles in 100+ languages, remove backgrounds, add AI voiceovers, and create polished videos — all in your browser with zero downloads. Save 80% editing time compared to traditional tools like Premiere Pro, at a fraction of the cost.

examples.prompt: Add automatic subtitles in English to this 5-minute product demo video and style them for social media
Remove the background from this interview footage and replace it with a professional office background

use_cases.title: Social Media Reels
use_cases.detail: Turn raw footage into viral-ready TikTok/Reels with auto-captions, music, and transitions in one click

use_cases.title: Course Video Editing
use_cases.detail: Batch-edit 50+ lesson videos with consistent branding, lower thirds, and chapter markers

use_cases.title: Multilingual Content
use_cases.detail: Auto-translate and dub your videos into 120+ languages with AI voice cloning

pros: No software to install — everything runs in the browser with automatic cloud saving
100+ language auto-subtitles with 95%+ accuracy, unmatched by competitors
All-in-one: editing, subtitles, screen recording, and AI voiceovers in one platform
cons: Browser-based means performance depends on internet speed and browser capabilities
Advanced color grading and multi-track editing still require professional software

description_en: Browser-based AI video editor used by 50M+ creators, with 100,000+ 5-star reviews. Auto-generate subtitles in 100+ languages, remove backgrounds, add AI voiceovers, and create polished videos — all in
description_zh: 浏览器端 AI 视频编辑器，被 5000 万以上创作者使用，收获 10 万以上五星好评。可自动生成 100 多种语言的字幕、去除背景、添加 AI 配音，并制作精美视频——全部在浏览器中完成，无需下载。相比 Premiere Pro 等传统工具可节省 80% 的剪辑时间，而成本仅为其一小部分。

name: ClickUp AI
description: AI-powered project management assistant that transforms ClickUp into an intelligent workspace for 2M+ teams. Features AI sprint planning, automated task breakdowns, meeting intelligence with action item extraction, and document drafting. Replaces multiple tools by bringing AI directly into your project workflows.

examples.prompt: Create a 12-week project plan for launching a new mobile app with tasks, milestones, and team assignments
Take these 15 messy meeting notes and organize them into actionable tasks with priorities and due dates

description_en: AI-powered project management assistant that transforms ClickUp into an intelligent workspace.
description_zh: AI 驱动的项目管理助手，为 200 万以上团队把 ClickUp 打造成智能工作空间。具备 AI 冲刺规划、任务自动拆解、带行动项提取的会议智能，以及文档起草功能。将 AI 直接引入项目工作流，从而替代多种工具。

name: AutoGPT
description: One of the first open-source autonomous agent experiments. It chains model calls to pursue a goal with tools and memory; maintained by the community as a research project.

examples.prompt: Research the best cities to start a tech company in 2026, create a comparison table, and draft a business plan outline
Plan a 3-week vacation to Europe with budget estimates, booking suggestions, and daily itinerary

description_en: One of the first open-source autonomous agent experiments. It chains model calls to pursue a goal with tools and memory; maintained by the community
description_zh: 最早出现的开源自主智能体实验项目之一。它通过串联模型调用，结合工具与记忆来推进目标，目前由社区作为研究项目维护。

name: AgentGPT
description: A browser-based autonomous agent: give it a goal and it plans, runs steps and reports results without you driving each turn.

examples.prompt: Create an agent to research and summarize the latest developments in quantum computing for a tech blog
Deploy an agent to monitor competitor pricing and send weekly summary reports

description_en: A browser-based autonomous agent: give it a goal and it plans, runs steps and reports results without you driving each turn.
description_zh: 基于浏览器的自主智能体：给它一个目标，它会自行规划、执行步骤并汇报结果，无需你逐轮驱动。

name: CrewAI
description: An open-source Python framework for orchestrating role-based multi-agent teams, with Flows for deterministic automation and tracing for debugging.

examples.prompt: Assemble a crew of AI agents to research, write, and edit a comprehensive e-book on sustainable living
Create a product development team with separate agents for market research, design, and technical specification

description_en: An open-source Python framework for orchestrating role-based multi-agent teams, with Flows for deterministic automation and tracing for debugging.
description_zh: 用于编排角色化多智能体团队的开源 Python 框架，提供实现确定性自动化的 Flows 和便于调试的追踪功能。

name: SurferSEO
description: SEO content tooling that scores drafts against currently ranking pages and gives keyword, structure and internal-link guidance while you write.

examples.prompt: Optimize this blog post about "remote work best practices" for top Google rankings with keyword recommendations
Analyze top-ranking competitors for "AI project management tools" and create a content strategy to outrank them

description_en: SEO content tooling that scores drafts against currently ranking pages and gives keyword, structure and internal-link guidance while you write.
description_zh: SEO 内容工具，可将草稿与当前排名靠前的页面对比打分，并在写作过程中给出关键词、结构和内链建议。

name: Frase
description: Researches a query, extracts the questions and headings competitors cover, then drafts briefs and content around the gaps.

examples.prompt: Create a comprehensive content brief for a guide to 'starting an online business in 2026' with all key sections
Answer these 15 common questions about 'sustainable fashion' to create an FAQ section that ranks well

description_en: Researches a query, extracts the questions and headings competitors cover, then drafts briefs and content around the gaps.
description_zh: 研究某个搜索词，提取竞争对手覆盖的问题与标题，再围绕内容缺口起草提纲和正文。

name: MarketMuse
description: A content strategy platform that uses topic models to plan content clusters, audit existing pages and prioritize by competitive gap and authority.

examples.prompt: Conduct a content audit of my website and identify gaps that are preventing me from ranking for key terms
Create a content cluster strategy for 'machine learning for beginners' to establish topical authority

description_en: A content strategy platform that uses topic models to plan content clusters, audit existing pages and prioritize by competitive gap and authority.
description_zh: 内容策略平台，利用主题模型规划内容集群、审计现有页面，并按竞争差距与权威性排定优先级。

name: Harvey
description: An AI assistant for law firms and tax teams, grounded in legal research with domain-tuned models and citations back to source material.

examples.prompt: Review this commercial lease agreement and flag potential issues and areas for negotiation
Research precedent cases about intellectual property disputes in the software industry

description_en: An AI assistant for law firms and tax teams, grounded in legal research with domain-tuned models and citations back to source material.
description_zh: 面向律所和税务团队的 AI 助手，以法律检索为基础，采用领域调优模型，并可回溯引用原始资料。

name: Kickresume
description: An AI resume and cover letter builder with ATS-oriented templates, bullet rewriting and a job-specific tailoring flow.

examples.prompt: Analyze my investment portfolio and suggest asset allocation adjustments based on my risk tolerance
Create a 5-year financial plan for saving for a house down payment with monthly savings targets

description_en: An AI resume and cover letter builder with ATS-oriented templates, bullet rewriting and a job-specific tailoring flow.
description_zh: AI 简历与求职信制作工具，提供面向 ATS 的模板、要点改写和针对具体岗位的定制流程。

name: Khanmigo
description: Khan Academy's AI tutor: Socratic-style guidance for students across subjects, plus lesson planning and grading helpers for teachers.

examples.prompt: Walk me through solving this calculus problem step by step and make sure I understand each concept
Create a 2-week study plan for my upcoming chemistry exam on organic chemistry reactions

description_en: Khan Academy's AI tutor: Socratic-style guidance for students across subjects, plus lesson planning and grading helpers for teachers.
description_zh: 可汗学院的 AI 家教：以苏格拉底式引导帮助学生学习各科，同时为教师提供备课与批改辅助。

name: Duolingo Max
description: Duolingo's top tier, adding roleplay conversations with characters and Explain My Answer on top of the standard lesson path.

examples.prompt: Practice a conversation in Spanish about ordering food at a restaurant with interactive feedback
Explain why I made this grammar mistake in French and give me similar examples to practice

description_en: Duolingo's top tier, adding roleplay conversations with characters and Explain My Answer on top of the standard lesson path.
description_zh: Duolingo 的顶配套餐，在标准学习路径之外增加了与角色进行的情景对话练习和「解释我的答案」功能。

name: Quizlet AI
description: Generates flashcards, practice tests and explanations from your own notes or textbooks, with adaptive study modes.

examples.prompt: Turn my biology textbook chapter on cell division into interactive flashcards with diagrams
Generate a practice test for my history exam on World War II with essay and multiple choice questions

description_en: Generates flashcards, practice tests and explanations from your own notes or textbooks, with adaptive study modes.
description_zh: 可根据你自己的笔记或教材生成闪卡、练习测试和讲解，并提供自适应学习模式。

name: Spline AI
description: A 3D design tool with prompt-to-3D generation, materials and animation, exporting interactive scenes for the web.

examples.prompt: Create a 3D model of a futuristic electric vehicle with smooth curves and metallic finish
Design an animated 3D logo for a tech startup that rotates and has a glowing effect

description_en: A 3D design tool with prompt-to-3D generation, materials and animation, exporting interactive scenes for the web.
description_zh: 3D 设计工具，支持提示词生成 3D、材质与动画，并可导出用于网页的交互式场景。

name: Meshy
description: Generates 3D models from text or reference images, with texturing, rigging and exports sized for game engines and 3D printing.

examples.prompt: Generate a 3D model of a cute fantasy creature with big eyes and fluffy tail, ready for game development
Turn this 2D concept art of a castle into a fully textured 3D model

description_en: Generates 3D models from text or reference images, with texturing, rigging and exports sized for game engines and 3D printing.
description_zh: 可根据文字或参考图生成 3D 模型，并支持贴图、绑定骨骼，以及导出适配游戏引擎和 3D 打印的尺寸。

name: Leonardo AI
description: An image generation platform with fine-tuned models, canvas editing, upscaling and asset pipelines aimed at game and product designers.

examples.prompt: Create concept art for a medieval fantasy RPG character with detailed armor and weapon design
Generate seamless texture maps for a sci-fi corridor wall with panel details and neon lights

description_en: An image generation platform with fine-tuned models, canvas editing, upscaling and asset pipelines aimed at game and product designers.
description_zh: 图像生成平台，提供微调模型、画布编辑、放大和素材流水线，主要面向游戏与产品设计师。

name: Soundraw

description: Google's source-grounded research assistant. You upload PDFs, documents, slides and web pages, then ask questions that are answered only from your own material with inline citations pointing back to the passage used. Can also generate audio overviews, mind maps and slide decks from your sources.
description_en: Google's source-grounded research assistant. You upload PDFs, documents, slides and web pages, then ask questions that are answered only from your own material with inline citations pointing back to the passage used. Can also generate audio overviews, mind maps and slide decks from your sources.
description_zh: Google 的基于素材来源的研究助手。你上传 PDF、文档、幻灯片和网页后即可提问，回答仅来自你提供的资料，并附内联引用指向所依据的原文段落。还能根据素材生成音频概览、思维导图和幻灯片。

name: You.com
description: AI search engine that pairs cited, synthesised answers with conventional web results. Its agentic mode runs multi-step research across sources, and the platform is built around a privacy-first posture with customisable search and chat modes.
description_en: AI search engine that pairs cited, synthesised answers with conventional web results. Its agentic mode runs multi-step research across sources, and the platform is built around a privacy-first posture with customisable search and chat modes.
description_zh: AI 搜索引擎，将带有引用来源的综合答案与传统网页结果结合起来。其智能体模式可跨来源执行多步研究，平台整体以隐私优先为理念，并提供可自定义的搜索与聊天模式。

name: Elicit
description: Research assistant built for literature reviews. It searches academic papers, then extracts structured fields — sample size, methods, key findings — into a comparison table, and summarises results across studies with citations attached to each claim.
description_en: Research assistant built for literature reviews. It searches academic papers, then extracts structured fields — sample size, methods, key findings — into a comparison table, and summarises results across studies with citations attached to each claim.
description_zh: 面向文献综述的研究助手。它检索学术论文，然后将样本量、研究方法、核心发现等结构化字段提取到对比表格中，并对各项研究进行汇总，每项结论都附有引用。

name: SciSpace
description: Academic platform that explains papers in plain language and lets you ask questions about a PDF with answers grounded in the text. Also covers citation management and literature review drafting, aimed at researchers working across many papers at once.
description_en: Academic platform that explains papers in plain language and lets you ask questions about a PDF with answers grounded in the text. Also covers citation management and literature review drafting, aimed at researchers working across many papers at once.
description_zh: 学术平台，用通俗语言解读论文，并允许你针对 PDF 提问，答案严格基于原文。此外还涵盖引用管理与文献综述起草，面向需要同时处理大量论文的研究人员。

name: Manus
description: General-purpose AI agent that carries multi-step tasks through to completion in a sandboxed cloud environment — research, coding, spreadsheet work and file production — instead of only answering questions. You hand over an objective and review the artefacts it returns.
description_en: General-purpose AI agent that carries multi-step tasks through to completion in a sandboxed cloud environment — research, coding, spreadsheet work and file production — instead of only answering questions. You hand over an objective and review the artefacts it returns.
description_zh: 通用 AI 智能体，可在沙箱云环境中把多步骤任务执行到底——包括研究、编程、表格处理和文件产出——而不仅仅是回答问题。你只需交付目标，再审视它返回的工作成果。

name: n8n
description: Source-available workflow automation platform with 400+ integrations and first-class AI and LLM nodes for building agentic automations. Because it can be self-hosted, credentials and data stay on your own infrastructure — a common requirement for teams with compliance constraints.
description_en: Source-available workflow automation platform with 400+ integrations and first-class AI and LLM nodes for building agentic automations. Because it can be self-hosted, credentials and data stay on your own infrastructure — a common requirement for teams with compliance constraints.
description_zh: 源代码可用的工作流自动化平台，拥有 400 多个集成，并提供一流的 AI 与 LLM 节点用于构建智能体自动化。由于支持自托管，凭证和数据都留在自己的基础设施上——这通常是受合规约束团队的硬性要求。

name: Dify
description: Open-source platform for shipping production AI applications, combining a visual workflow builder, RAG pipeline, prompt management and agent tooling with built-in observability. Lets teams move from prototype to deployed service without rebuilding the surrounding infrastructure.
description_en: Open-source platform for shipping production AI applications, combining a visual workflow builder, RAG pipeline, prompt management and agent tooling with built-in observability. Lets teams move from prototype to deployed service without rebuilding the surrounding infrastructure.
description_zh: 用于交付生产级 AI 应用的开源平台，集可视化工作流编排、RAG 流水线、提示词管理与智能体工具于一体，并内置可观测性。让团队从原型平滑走向已部署的服务，无需重建周边基础设施。

name: Lindy
description: Platform for building AI agents that take over recurring business work — triaging email, scheduling meetings, updating CRM records, drafting support replies — connected to 300+ third-party apps without writing code.
description_en: Platform for building AI agents that take over recurring business work — triaging email, scheduling meetings, updating CRM records, drafting support replies — connected to 300+ third-party apps without writing code.
description_zh: 构建 AI 智能体的平台，可接管日常重复性业务工作——邮件分类、会议安排、更新 CRM 记录、起草客服回复——无需编码即可连接 300 多个第三方应用。

name: Gumloop
description: No-code platform for assembling AI workflows and agents through a node-based editor. Aimed at non-technical teams that want to chain LLM steps with everyday business tools such as spreadsheets, CRMs and email.
description_en: No-code platform for assembling AI workflows and agents through a node-based editor. Aimed at non-technical teams that want to chain LLM steps with everyday business tools such as spreadsheets, CRMs and email.
description_zh: 通过节点编辑器组装 AI 工作流与智能体的无代码平台。面向希望把 LLM 步骤与电子表格、CRM、邮件等日常业务工具串联起来的非技术团队。

name: Zapier
description: Automation platform connecting thousands of business apps, extended with AI agents and natural-language workflow building. Its value is breadth of integration — useful when the task involves moving data between tools that have no native connection.
description_en: Automation platform connecting thousands of business apps, extended with AI agents and natural-language workflow building. Its value is breadth of integration — useful when the task involves moving data between tools that have no native connection.
description_zh: 连接数千款商业应用的自动化平台，并扩展了 AI 智能体与自然语言工作流搭建能力。它的价值在于集成的广度——当任务需要在没有原生连接的工具之间搬运数据时尤为实用。

name: ComfyUI
description: Node-based open-source interface for Stable Diffusion and other diffusion models. It exposes the entire generation pipeline as an editable graph, giving precise control over sampling, conditioning, upscaling and LoRA stacking. Runs locally, so no usage fees and no data leaves your machine.
description_en: Node-based open-source interface for Stable Diffusion and other diffusion models. It exposes the entire generation pipeline as an editable graph, giving precise control over sampling, conditioning, upscaling and LoRA stacking. Runs locally, so no usage fees and no data leaves your machine.
description_zh: 面向 Stable Diffusion 及其他扩散模型的节点式开源界面。它将整个生成流程暴露为可编辑的图，让你可以精确控制采样、条件控制、放大和 LoRA 叠加。完全在本地运行，因此没有使用费，数据也不会离开你的机器。

name: Freepik AI
description: AI image and video generation suite built on top of Freepik's stock library. Includes a text-to-image generator, AI upscaler, background remover and retouching tools, which makes it practical for quickly producing commercial-ready marketing visuals with licensing already handled.
description_en: AI image and video generation suite built on top of Freepik's stock library. Includes a text-to-image generator, AI upscaler, background remover and retouching tools, which makes it practical for quickly producing commercial-ready marketing visuals with licensing already handled.
description_zh: 构建在 Freepik 素材库之上的 AI 图像与视频生成套件。包含文生图生成器、AI 放大器、背景去除和修图工具，可快速产出可直接商用的营销视觉素材，且授权问题已预先解决。

name: CapCut
description: ByteDance's video editor, widely used for TikTok, Reels and Shorts production. Its AI features cover auto-captions with translation, background removal, text-to-speech, and template-driven short-form editing, available free on desktop and mobile.
description_en: ByteDance's video editor, widely used for TikTok, Reels and Shorts production. Its AI features cover auto-captions with translation, background removal, text-to-speech, and template-driven short-form editing, available free on desktop and mobile.
description_zh: 字节跳动旗下的视频编辑器，广泛用于 TikTok、Reels 和 Shorts 内容制作。其 AI 功能涵盖带翻译的自动字幕、背景去除、文本转语音以及模板化短视频剪辑，桌面端和移动端均可免费使用。

name: Vidu
description: Text- and image-to-video model from ShengShu Technology, with emphasis on keeping subjects consistent across shots and giving explicit camera-motion control. Aimed at short narrative clips and concept visualisation rather than long-form production.
description_en: Text- and image-to-video model from ShengShu Technology, with emphasis on keeping subjects consistent across shots and giving explicit camera-motion control. Aimed at short narrative clips and concept visualisation rather than long-form production. The S2 release adds real-time 720p editable output and interactive avatar characters.
description_zh: 生数科技推出的文本与图像转视频模型，侧重保持主体在不同镜头间的一致性，并提供明确的镜头运动控制。面向短叙事片段和概念可视化，而非长片制作。

name: Hedra
description: AI video tool for generating expressive talking-character clips from a single portrait image and an audio track. Focuses on lip-sync accuracy and facial performance, which makes it a common choice for character-led explainer and social content.
description_en: AI video tool for generating expressive talking-character clips from a single portrait image and an audio track. Focuses on lip-sync accuracy and facial performance, which makes it a common choice for character-led explainer and social content.
description_zh: AI 视频工具，可用单张人像照片和一段音频生成富有表现力的说话人物短片。注重口型同步精度与面部表演，因此常被用于角色主导的讲解和社交内容。

name: Argil
description: AI video platform for producing avatar-led marketing and training videos, with voice cloning and multi-language translation built in. Lets a single script be republished across markets without re-recording.
description_en: AI video platform for producing avatar-led marketing and training videos, with voice cloning and multi-language translation built in. Lets a single script be republished across markets without re-recording.
description_zh: AI 视频平台，用于制作以虚拟形象为主导的营销与培训视频，内置声音克隆和多语言翻译。同一份脚本无需重新录制即可在多个市场复用发布。

name: Higgsfield
description: AI-native creative suite for cinematic image and video generation, offering a library of preset camera moves and motion controls. Geared toward short-form and advertising work where a specific shot feel matters more than raw generation speed.
description_en: AI-native creative suite for cinematic image and video generation, offering a library of preset camera moves and motion controls. Geared toward short-form and advertising work where a specific shot feel matters more than raw generation speed.
description_zh: 面向电影感图像与视频生成的 AI 原生创作套件，提供预置镜头运动和运镜控制库。适用于短视频和广告制作——在这类场景中，特定镜头质感比纯粹的生成速度更重要。

name: Wispr Flow
description: Voice dictation app that converts speech into clean, formatted prose in any Mac or Windows application. Handles punctuation automatically and strips filler words, so dictation arrives as finished text rather than a raw transcript.
description_en: Voice dictation app that converts speech into clean, formatted prose in any Mac or Windows application. Handles punctuation automatically and strips filler words, so dictation arrives as finished text rather than a raw transcript.
description_zh: 语音输入应用，可在 Mac 或 Windows 的任意程序中把语音转化为整洁、有格式的文字。自动处理标点并剔除口头赘词，因此得到的是可直接使用的成稿，而非原始转写稿。

name: Superwhisper
description: Voice-to-text for macOS, Windows and iOS that runs models on-device, so audio never leaves your machine. Supports custom vocabulary and formatting presets, and is often chosen where confidentiality rules out cloud transcription.
description_en: Voice-to-text for macOS, Windows and iOS that runs models on-device, so audio never leaves your machine. Supports custom vocabulary and formatting presets, and is often chosen where confidentiality rules out cloud transcription.
description_zh: 支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 的语音转文字工具，模型完全在设备端运行，音频不会离开你的机器。支持自定义词库和格式预设，在保密要求不允许云端转写的场景下常被选用。

name: Granola
description: AI notepad for meetings that transcribes in the background and merges the transcript with your own typed notes into a structured summary. No bot joins the call, which avoids the awkwardness of a visible participant and works with in-person meetings.
description_en: AI notepad for meetings that transcribes in the background and merges the transcript with your own typed notes into a structured summary. No bot joins the call, which avoids the awkwardness of a visible participant and works with in-person meetings.
description_zh: 面向会议的 AI 记事本，在后台转写，并将转写内容与你手打的笔记融合成结构化摘要。没有机器人加入会议，避免了出现一个可见参会者的尴尬，也适用于线下会议。

name: Fathom
description: Meeting notetaker that records, transcribes and summarises Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls, then drafts follow-up emails. The free tier is unusually generous, and paid plans add CRM sync so notes land on the right record automatically.
description_en: Meeting notetaker that records, transcribes and summarises Zoom, Google Meet and Teams calls, then drafts follow-up emails. The free tier is unusually generous, and paid plans add CRM sync so notes land on the right record automatically.
description_zh: 会议记录工具，可录制、转写并总结 Zoom、Google Meet 和 Teams 通话，随后起草跟进邮件。免费额度相当慷慨，付费方案还增加 CRM 同步，让笔记自动归到对应记录下。

name: AssemblyAI
description: Speech-to-text API for developers, covering speaker diarisation, sentiment and topic detection, sentiment analysis and PII redaction. Built for production pipelines that need reliable transcription plus structured metadata extracted from the audio.
description_en: Speech-to-text API for developers, covering speaker diarisation, sentiment and topic detection, sentiment analysis and PII redaction. Built for production pipelines that need reliable transcription plus structured metadata extracted from the audio.
description_zh: 面向开发者的语音转文字 API，支持说话人分离、主题与情感检测、情感分析以及个人敏感信息（PII）脱敏。专为需要可靠转写并从音频中提取结构化元数据的生产流水线而设计。

name: Deepgram
description: Voice AI API provider offering real-time and batch speech recognition plus text-to-speech. Known for low-latency streaming and domain-tuned language models, it is commonly used for live captioning and contact-centre analytics.
description_en: Voice AI API provider offering real-time and batch speech recognition plus text-to-speech. Known for low-latency streaming and domain-tuned language models, it is commonly used for live captioning and contact-centre analytics.
description_zh: 语音 AI API 服务商，提供实时与批量语音识别以及文本转语音。以低延迟流式传输和面向特定领域调优的语言模型著称，常用于实时字幕和呼叫中心分析。

name: Typeface
description: Enterprise content platform that produces on-brand marketing assets at scale. Brand kits, approved templates and campaign workflows keep generated copy and imagery within guidelines, which is the main reason large teams choose it over general-purpose writing tools.
description_en: Enterprise content platform that produces on-brand marketing assets at scale. Brand kits, approved templates and campaign workflows keep generated copy and imagery within guidelines, which is the main reason large teams choose it over general-purpose writing tools.
description_zh: 企业级内容平台，可规模化产出符合品牌规范的营销物料。品牌工具包、审批通过的模板和营销活动工作流，确保生成的文案与图像始终在规范之内，这正是大型团队选择它而非通用写作工具的主要原因。

name: SlidesAI
description: Google Slides add-on that turns a text outline or document into a formatted slide deck, including speaker notes and suggested imagery. Useful when the content already exists and only the slide layout is missing.
description_en: Google Slides add-on that turns a text outline or document into a formatted slide deck, including speaker notes and suggested imagery. Useful when the content already exists and only the slide layout is missing.
description_zh: Google Slides 插件，可将文本大纲或文档转换为排版好的幻灯片，并包含演讲者备注和配图建议。当内容已就绪、只差幻灯片排版时尤为实用。

name: Saner.ai
description: AI personal assistant that folds notes, tasks and calendar into one workspace, designed with ADHD-friendly workflows: fast capture, automatic prioritisation, and chat over your own notes rather than a separate knowledge base.
description_en: AI personal assistant that folds notes, tasks and calendar into one workspace, designed with ADHD-friendly workflows: fast capture, automatic prioritisation, and chat over your own notes rather than a separate knowledge base.
description_zh: AI 个人助理，将笔记、任务和日历整合到一个工作空间，并采用对 ADHD 友好的工作流设计：快速记录、自动排优先级，以及基于你自己的笔记进行对话，而非依赖独立知识库。

name: Genspark
description: An AI agent workspace that researches a topic and returns a structured "sparkpage" instead of a chat thread, with agents that also produce slide decks, spreadsheets and call summaries from one prompt.
description_en: An AI agent workspace that researches a topic and returns a structured "sparkpage" instead of a chat thread, with agents that also produce slide decks, spreadsheets and call summaries from one prompt.
description_zh: AI 智能体工作空间，会先研究某个主题，再返回结构化的「sparkpage」而非对话串；其智能体还能通过一条提示生成幻灯片、电子表格和通话摘要。

name: Paperpal
description: An academic writing assistant from Cactus Communications that checks manuscripts for language, structure and journal fit, with pre-submission checks used by researchers and publishers.
description_en: An academic writing assistant from Cactus Communications that checks manuscripts for language, structure and journal fit, with pre-submission checks used by researchers and publishers.
description_zh: Cactus Communications 推出的学术写作助手，可检查稿件的语言、结构与期刊匹配度，其投稿前检查功能被研究人员和出版机构广泛使用。

name: Monica
description: An all-in-one AI assistant available as a browser extension, desktop and mobile app. Bundles chat across several models, page and video summarization, translation, writing help and image tools in one sidebar.
description_en: An all-in-one AI assistant available as a browser extension, desktop and mobile app. Bundles chat across several models, page and video summarization, translation, writing help and image tools in one sidebar.
description_zh: 一体化 AI 助手，提供浏览器扩展、桌面端和移动端应用。在侧边栏中整合了多模型对话、网页与视频摘要、翻译、写作辅助和图像工具。

name: Trae
description: ByteDance's AI-native IDE for macOS and Windows. Builder mode plans and writes multi-file features, the agent runs terminal commands and debugging, and mainstream models are available at no cost.
description_en: ByteDance's AI-native IDE for macOS and Windows. Builder mode plans and writes multi-file features, the agent runs terminal commands and debugging, and mainstream models are available at no cost.
description_zh: 字节跳动推出的 AI 原生 IDE，支持 macOS 和 Windows。Builder 模式可规划并编写跨多文件的功能，智能体能执行终端命令和调试，主流模型均可免费使用。

name: Jules
description: Google's asynchronous coding agent. Point it at a GitHub repository, describe the task, and it clones the repo into a cloud VM, writes a plan, produces a diff and opens a pull request for you to review.
description_en: Google's asynchronous coding agent. Point it at a GitHub repository, describe the task, and it clones the repo into a cloud VM, writes a plan, produces a diff and opens a pull request for you to review.
description_zh: Google 的异步编程智能体。把它指向某个 GitHub 仓库、描述任务，它就会把仓库克隆到云虚拟机中，写出计划、生成 diff 并为你发起 Pull Request 供审查。

name: OpenHands
description: An open-source platform for AI software engineering agents. Run it locally, in CI or hosted, and let the agent edit files, run commands, browse the web and open pull requests.
description_en: An open-source platform for AI software engineering agents. Run it locally, in CI or hosted, and let the agent edit files, run commands, browse the web and open pull requests.
description_zh: 面向 AI 软件工程智能体的开源平台。可在本地、CI 或托管环境中运行，让智能体编辑文件、执行命令、浏览网页并创建 Pull Request。

name: Google Flow
description: Google's AI filmmaking tool built on Veo and Imagen. Generate scenes from text or images, control camera moves, keep characters consistent between shots and assemble everything on a scenebuilder timeline.
description_en: Google's AI filmmaking tool built on Veo and Imagen. Generate scenes from text or images, control camera moves, keep characters consistent between shots and assemble everything on a scenebuilder timeline.
description_zh: Google 基于 Veo 和 Imagen 打造的 AI 影视创作工具。可从文本或图像生成场景、控制镜头运动、保持角色在不同镜头间一致，并在 scenebuilder 时间线上完成整体组装。

name: Google Veo
description: Google DeepMind video generation models that produce clips with native audio, camera control and reference-image conditioning. Reachable through Gemini, Flow and the Gemini API.
description_en: Google DeepMind video generation models that produce clips with native audio, camera control and reference-image conditioning. Reachable through Gemini, Flow and the Gemini API.
description_zh: Google DeepMind 的视频生成模型，可生成带原生音频、支持镜头控制与参考图条件的片段。可通过 Gemini、Flow 和 Gemini API 使用。

name: LTX Studio
description: Lightricks' AI storyboarding and video studio. Build a story from script to shot list, keep characters and camera consistent per scene, then render and export for further editing.
description_en: Lightricks' AI storyboarding and video studio. Build a story from script to shot list, keep characters and camera consistent per scene, then render and export for further editing.
description_zh: Lightricks 推出的 AI 分镜与视频工作室。可从脚本一路搭建到镜头清单，按场景保持角色与镜头一致，再渲染导出以便进一步剪辑。

name: Magnific
description: An AI upscaler and image enhancer that reimagines texture and lighting rather than just sharpening pixels, with sliders for resemblance, creativity and detail.
description_en: An AI upscaler and image enhancer that reimagines texture and lighting rather than just sharpening pixels, with sliders for resemblance, creativity and detail.
description_zh: AI 图像放大与增强工具，不只是锐化像素，而是重新生成纹理与光照，并提供相似度、创意度和细节等滑块调节。

name: FLUX
description: Black Forest Labs image models (FLUX.2) plus video generation and editing, offered through the BFL playground, an API and third-party model hosts.
description_en: Black Forest Labs image models (FLUX.2) plus video generation and editing, offered through the BFL playground, an API and third-party model hosts.
description_zh: Black Forest Labs 的图像模型（FLUX.2），并提供视频生成与编辑能力，可通过 BFL 试验场、API 以及第三方模型托管平台使用。

name: Resemble AI
description: A voice AI platform for custom voice cloning, speech-to-speech conversion, real-time synthesis and dubbing, used in games, film localization and contact-center products.
description_en: A voice AI platform for custom voice cloning, speech-to-speech conversion, real-time synthesis and dubbing, used in games, film localization and contact-center products.
description_zh: 语音 AI 平台，提供定制声音克隆、语音转语音转换、实时合成与配音，应用于游戏、影视本地化和呼叫中心产品。

name: Riverside
description: A remote recording studio that captures separate local audio and video tracks per guest, then transcribes the session and turns it into shareable clips.
description_en: A remote recording studio that captures separate local audio and video tracks per guest, then transcribes the session and turns it into shareable clips.
description_zh: 远程录音工作室，可为每位嘉宾分别采集本地音视频轨道，随后转写会话内容并剪辑成便于分享的片段。

name: Fyxer
description: An AI assistant for email that drafts replies in your own voice, triages the inbox, takes meeting notes and files messages, working on top of Gmail and Outlook.
description_en: An AI assistant for email that drafts replies in your own voice, triages the inbox, takes meeting notes and files messages, working on top of Gmail and Outlook.
description_zh: 邮件 AI 助手，以你自己的口吻起草回复、对收件箱分类、记录会议笔记并归档邮件，运行在 Gmail 和 Outlook 之上。

name: Shortwave
description: An AI email client with thread summarization, natural-language search across your whole mailbox and an assistant that drafts replies using your own email history.
description_en: An AI email client with thread summarization, natural-language search across your whole mailbox and an assistant that drafts replies using your own email history.
description_zh: AI 邮件客户端，支持会话摘要、覆盖整个邮箱的自然语言搜索，以及基于你自身邮件历史起草回复的助手。

name: Dust
description: A platform for building AI agents connected to company data such as Slack, Notion, Drive and GitHub, with configurable assistants, tool use and shared team workspaces.
description_en: A platform for building AI agents connected to company data such as Slack, Notion, Drive and GitHub, with configurable assistants, tool use and shared team workspaces.
description_zh: 构建 AI 智能体的平台，可连接 Slack、Notion、Drive、GitHub 等公司数据，支持可配置的助手、工具调用和团队共享工作空间。

name: Relevance AI
description: A no-code platform for building and deploying teams of AI agents, with a visual workflow builder, a tool library and integrations for sales, support and operations work.
description_en: A no-code platform for building and deploying teams of AI agents, with a visual workflow builder, a tool library and integrations for sales, support and operations work.
description_zh: 无需代码即可构建和部署 AI 智能体团队的平台，提供可视化工作流编排器、工具库，以及面向销售、客服和运营的集成能力。

name: Clay
description: A data enrichment and outbound platform that pulls from 100+ data sources and runs AI research agents over each row to build and personalize go-to-market lists.
description_en: A data enrichment and outbound platform that pulls from 100+ data sources and runs AI research agents over each row to build and personalize go-to-market lists.
description_zh: 数据充实与外联平台，可从 100 多个数据源抓取信息，并对每一行运行 AI 调研智能体，以构建并个性化营销触达名单。

name: Supermaven
description: AI code completion built for speed, with a context window large enough to pull in far more of your codebase than a typical autocomplete. Ships as a plugin for VS Code, JetBrains and Neovim, so you keep the editor you already use. A strong pick if you want inline suggestions without migrating to a whole new IDE.

examples.prompt: Autocomplete this TypeScript API client using the types defined elsewhere in the repo
Generate a database migration from this updated Prisma schema

description_en: Fast AI code completion with a large context window, as a plugin for your existing editor.
description_zh: 为速度而生的 AI 代码补全工具，上下文窗口足够大，能比普通自动补全引入多得多的代码库内容。以插件形式支持 VS Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim，因此你可以继续使用现有编辑器。如果你想获得行内建议、又不想迁移到全新 IDE，它是不错的选择。

name: Zencoder
description: An AI coding agent that works at repository level from inside your IDE — writing features, repairing broken code and generating unit tests with awareness of your existing conventions. Aimed at professional teams that want agentic help without leaving their current editors.

examples.prompt: Add input validation and unit tests to this Express route handler
Find why the build fails after this dependency upgrade and patch it

description_en: AI coding agent for IDEs that writes, repairs and tests code with repo-level context.
description_zh: 在 IDE 内以仓库级视角工作的 AI 编程智能体——编写功能、修复问题代码、生成单元测试，并能理解你既有的代码约定。面向希望在不离开现有编辑器的前提下获得智能体协助的专业团队。

name: Greptile
description: AI code review and codebase question-answering. It indexes your repositories so you can ask plain-language questions about how things fit together, and posts automated review comments on pull requests. Especially useful when onboarding onto an unfamiliar codebase or reviewing large diffs.

examples.prompt: Explain how authentication is wired up across this repository
Review this pull request for race conditions and error handling gaps

description_en: AI code review and codebase Q&A that indexes your repositories.
description_zh: AI 代码审查与代码库问答工具。它会为你的仓库建立索引，让你可以用自然语言提问各部分如何关联，并在 Pull Request 上自动发表审查评论。在接手陌生代码库或审查大型改动时尤其有用。

name: Base44
description: Describe an app in plain language and Base44 generates a working full-stack application — database, backend and interface included. Built for people who want a real, running app rather than a clickable mockup, and comfortable starting from a sentence instead of a scaffold.

examples.prompt: Build a booking app where clients pick a time slot and get a confirmation email
Create an internal inventory tracker with roles for staff and admins

description_en: Turn plain-language app descriptions into working full-stack applications.
description_zh: 用自然语言描述一个应用，Base44 就能生成可运行的全栈应用——包含数据库、后端和界面。适合想要真正能跑起来的应用、而非可点击原型的人，也适合习惯从一句话开始而不是从脚手架开始的人。

name: Sesame
description: Sesame builds conversational voice AI — speech models designed to sound like a real person in a live back-and-forth rather than a narrator reading a script. Best suited to voice assistants and interactive characters, where how something is said carries as much meaning as the words themselves.

examples.prompt: Read this customer support reply in a calm, reassuring tone
Narrate this short story with warm, expressive delivery

description_en: Conversational voice AI built to sound natural in live, back-and-forth speech.
description_zh: Sesame 打造的是对话式语音 AI——其语音模型旨在听起来像真人在实时交谈，而非照稿朗读的旁白。最适合语音助手和交互式角色，在这类场景中「怎么说」与「说什么」同样重要。

name: Hume AI
description: Hume works on emotion in voice — both producing expressive speech and reading emotional cues out of audio. It fits voice interfaces that should react to how someone sounds rather than only to what they said, and it also offers expression analysis across speech, text and facial video.

examples.prompt: Deliver this line with genuine excitement instead of flat enthusiasm
Analyse the emotional tone of this customer call recording

description_en: Emotionally expressive voice AI that also reads emotional cues from audio.
description_zh: Hume 专注于语音中的情绪——既能生成富有表现力的语音，也能从音频中读出情绪线索。适用于需要依据用户说话方式（而不只是说话内容）作出反应的语音界面；此外还提供涵盖语音、文本和面部视频的表情分析。

name: Cartesia
description: Low-latency text-to-speech built for real-time use — voice agents, live translation, anywhere a pause is immediately obvious. Offers fast streaming synthesis and voice cloning through an API, which makes it a practical choice when response time matters more than squeezing out the last bit of polish.

examples.prompt: Synthesise this reply fast enough to keep a live voice agent call natural
Clone this narrator voice and read a product walkthrough

description_en: Low-latency text-to-speech and voice cloning built for real-time applications.
description_zh: 为实时场景打造的低延迟文本转语音——语音智能体、实时同传，任何停顿都会被立刻察觉的场合。通过 API 提供快速流式合成与声音克隆，当响应速度比极致打磨更重要时，是务实之选。

name: OpenClaw
description: Open-source, self-hosted AI assistant that executes multi-step tasks on your own machine or private server rather than answering one-off prompts in a browser. Runs locally with no per-token billing, supports installable skills from ClawHub, and keeps files and credentials on hardware you control. Popular with developers who want agent autonomy without sending data to a third party.
description_en: Open-source self-hosted AI assistant that runs multi-step agent tasks locally, keeping your data on your own hardware.
description_zh: 开源、可自托管的 AI 助手，在你自己的机器或私有服务器上执行多步骤任务，而非在浏览器里回答一次性提问。本地运行、无按 token 计费，支持从 ClawHub 安装技能，文件与凭证都留在你掌控的硬件上。深受既想要智能体自主性、又不想把数据发给第三方的开发者欢迎。

name: Seedance 2.0
description: ByteDance text-to-video model known for coherent human motion, controllable camera work and multi-shot generation from a single prompt. Aimed at advertising, short drama and marketing video, where it replaces scenes that previously needed a crew and a location. Accessed through Volcano Engine with API availability for production pipelines.
description_en: ByteDance video generation model with coherent motion and camera control, built for advertising and short-form marketing video.
description_zh: 字节跳动的文生视频模型，以人物动作连贯、运镜可控以及单次提示生成多镜头著称。面向广告、短剧和营销视频，可替代以往需要团队和外景才能完成的场景。通过火山引擎访问，并提供 API 供生产流水线接入。

name: Google Antigravity
description: Google agent-first development environment where you delegate work to agents that plan, write and verify code across a whole project instead of completing single suggestions. Built around long-running agent sessions, artifact review and integration with Google model stack and cloud services.
description_en: Google agent-first development environment that delegates whole-project coding work to agents with reviewable artifacts.
description_zh: Google 的智能体优先开发环境，你把工作交给智能体，由它们在整个项目范围内规划、编写并验证代码，而非只完成单条建议。围绕长时间运行的智能体会话、产物评审，以及与 Google 模型栈和云服务的集成构建。

name: Windsurf
description: Agentic IDE built around the Cascade agent, which tracks your edits, commands and project context so it can refactor across files rather than one line at a time. Handles multi-file refactors, terminal commands and project-wide context. Google licensed the technology and hired the founders in July 2025, and Cognition acquired the remaining company the same month. Windsurf 2.0 folded Devin Cloud into every self-serve plan in April 2026; on June 2, 2026 the editor was renamed Devin Desktop, with Cascade, keybindings and extensions unchanged. Pro rose from $15 to $20 per month alongside a new $200 Max tier.
description_en: Agentic IDE built around the Cascade agent, which tracks your edits, commands and project context so it can refactor across files instead of one at a time. Google licensed the tech and hired the founders in July 2025, and Cognition acquired the remaining company the same month. Windsurf 2.0 folded Devin Cloud into every self-serve plan in April 2026; on June 2, 2026 the editor was renamed Devin Desktop, with Cascade, keybindings and extensions unchanged.
description_zh: 以 Cascade 智能体为核心的代理式 IDE，它会追踪你的编辑、命令和项目上下文，从而跨文件重构而非逐行修改。可处理多文件重构、终端命令与项目级上下文。Google 于 2025 年 7 月授权该技术并招募了创始团队，同月 Cognition 收购了剩余公司。Windsurf 2.0 于 2026 年 4 月将 Devin Cloud 纳入所有自助套餐；2026 年 6 月 2 日该编辑器更名为 Devin Desktop，Cascade、快捷键和扩展均保持不变。Pro 套餐从每月 15 美元涨至 20 美元，同时新增 200 美元的 Max 套餐。

name: Lyria
description: Google DeepMind music generation model producing high-fidelity stereo tracks with verse and chorus structure from text or image prompts. Lyria 3.5 adds custom lyrics, timestamp-based structural control and SynthID watermarking on all generated audio. Available through AI Studio, the Gemini API and the Gemini app.
description_en: Google DeepMind music model that generates structured stereo tracks from prompts, with lyrics control and audio watermarking.
description_zh: Google DeepMind 的音乐生成模型，可根据文本或图像提示生成带主歌与副歌结构的高保真立体声轨。Lyria 3.5 新增自定义歌词、基于时间戳的结构控制，并对所有生成音频添加 SynthID 水印。可通过 AI Studio、Gemini API 和 Gemini 应用使用。

name: Qwen-Image
description: Alibaba open-weight image generation and editing model. The 2.1 release runs at 7B parameters, handles transparent RGBA output and accepts up to 10 reference images for editing, and claims to outperform closed models on its own benchmark. Released under a research licence; commercial use requires approval.
description_en: Alibaba's open-weight 7B image model with RGBA output and multi-reference editing, free for research use.
description_zh: 阿里巴巴的开放权重图像生成与编辑模型。2.1 版本参数量为 7B，支持透明 RGBA 输出，编辑时最多可接受 10 张参考图，并宣称在自有基准上优于闭源模型。采用研究许可发布；商用需获得授权。

name: Ollama
description: Open-source runtime for running large language models locally on macOS, Linux and Windows with a single command. Ships a model library covering Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma and Phi, exposes a local REST API and OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and is the default backbone for self-hosted agent stacks and private RAG pipelines. Popular with developers who need model access with no network dependency and no per-token bill.
description_en: Run open-weight LLMs locally with one command, exposing a local API for agents, RAG and private chatbots.
description_zh: 开源运行时，一条命令即可在 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 本地运行大语言模型。内置涵盖 Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma 和 Phi 的模型库，提供本地 REST API 与 OpenAI 兼容端点，是自托管智能体技术栈和私有 RAG 流水线的默认底座。深受需要无网络依赖、无按 token 计费地访问模型的开发者欢迎。

name: LM Studio
description: Desktop application for discovering, downloading and running open-weight language models on your own hardware, with a graphical chat interface and a built-in local inference server. Supports GGUF and MLX formats, lets you tune context length and GPU offload without a terminal, and can expose an OpenAI-compatible API so local models drop into existing agent and coding tools.
description_en: Desktop app for running local LLMs with a GUI and a built-in OpenAI-compatible local server.
description_zh: 桌面应用，可在你自己的硬件上发现、下载并运行开放权重语言模型，提供图形化聊天界面和内置本地推理服务器。支持 GGUF 和 MLX 格式，无需终端即可调整上下文长度和 GPU 卸载，并可暴露 OpenAI 兼容 API，让本地模型直接接入现有的智能体与编程工具。
